dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped light-toned rings across the mid-lateral flank; the most prominent annuli exhibit a sharp, high-intensity outer perimeter with a well-defined gradient transition to a darker, low-intensity core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, asymmetrical high-intensity pixel clusters concentrated along the dorsal ridge and the posterior-lateral transition zone.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent lateral macro-annuli form an obtuse triangle; primary high-intensity blobs on the upper dorsal region form a trapezoidal spatial relationship relative to the lateral rings.

other_distinctive_markers: A singular, isolated high-intensity white pixel speck located on the lower posterior-ventral margin, contrasting significantly with the surrounding dark-toned pixels.
